recipe.create_render_context: PARAMS_28 with use_fast_math=False (all other 27 params identical to S0b)
recipe.purpose: RGB <=1 LSB pass criterion for product WARP_1_15_RENDER (fast_math=false); S0b fast-math RGB difference is a recorded known cross-recipe deviation

encoding.rgb: packed u32 ABGR-A8: a=255; channels = (a<<24)|(r<<16)|(g<<8)|b, r/g/b = int(clamp(channel,0,1)*255) (truncation, not rounding); unpack = float32(byte) * float32(1/255), upstream `unpack_rgb_kernel`

source.semantics: raw rc.rgb_data (packed ABGR, a=255) and raw rc.depth_data/rc.seg_data

cross_recipe.treatment: byte-diff histogram is a known cross-recipe deviation record (not a pass criterion); pass criterion is same-recipe <=1 LSB
